season.evidence: Search found route pages (west rib via PCT from Rainy Pass) but no season statement; logged ascents run May-Oct with June most common (7), Sep 2. Stored Jul-Sep kept; Jun 19 is within a month.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sep 1, complete round trip from the Rainy Pass PCT start (4 m from pin) with summit, but no logged route name or report; its line enters from the north side near 48.541,-120.709 so it may be the north ridge, not the west rib.

Jun 19 one-way from Rainy Pass arriving from the west; report only says class 3 near the top and a rappel down the upper gully; no route named, and other Molar Tooth routes exist (NE Arete, NE Chimney).
Turned back below the top rock, too wet, Jun 11.

facts.text: From the Rainy Pass PCT trailhead the round trip is roughly 4.5 miles with about 2,500 ft of gain.
In mid-June the upper gully used for rappelling is loose, and rock near the top may be too wet to climb.

notes: Track identity is the issue: the Rainy Pass start fits our second approach but neither track names its route, so none is assigned. Trailhead pin already within 4 m of both recordings.
